rationale: CORRECTNESS GATE — has genuine teeth. The union_of_traverse helper (conformance.rs:45-85) is defined independently: it calls store.traverse() per seed (the slow per-seed path), deduplicates nodes by symbol and edges by dedup_key, and folds MIN depth — it does NOT call traverse_multi. Comparing store.traverse_multi(...) against this independent fold means any deviation in SqliteStore's CTE override (wrong subgraph, wrong exclusions, wrong min-depth) causes a failure the fold would not share. Fixture discriminators verified: (1) tm_s2 is reachable from tm_s1 (cross-reachable seed — must be excluded from depths; asserted at line 171); (2) tm_m1 is reached from BOTH seeds at depth 1 (min-depth dedup; asserted at line 161); (3) tm_m1→tm_leaf is a multi-hop path; (4) tm_leaf at min-depth 1 via tm_s2→tm_leaf (asserted at line 166). The test runs both Direction::Dependencies and Direction::Both, checking node-set, edge-set, and depths equality. Hardcoded depth assertions in the final block catch bugs shared by the fold and the override. Re-run: 7 passed; 0 failed.
